scripts.title: AutoFarm
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local TARGET_POSITION = Vector3.new(2033, 541, -1627)
local TELEPORT_INTERVAL = 1
local TOGGLE_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://6698737249"

local enabled = false
local panelOpen = true
local teleporting = false

local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("TeleportPanelPro")
if old then old:Destroy() end

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "TeleportPanelPro"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 50
gui.Parent = playerGui

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "Main"
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(290, 205)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0.35, 0)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(19, 22, 32)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 115, 255)
stroke.Transparency = 0.2
stroke.Thickness = 1.5
stroke.Parent = main

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 49)
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.Parent = main
Instance.new("UICorner", header).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

local headerCover = Instance.new("Frame")
headerCover.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12)
headerCover.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
headerCover.BackgroundColor3 = header.BackgroundColor3
headerCover.BorderSizePixel = 0
headerCover.Parent = header

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 1, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "TELEPORT  /  PRO"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 246, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 15
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = header

local hideButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
hideButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 30)
hideButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 9)
hideButton.Text = "—"
hideButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
hideButton.TextSize = 18
hideButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
hideButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 60, 80)
hideButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
hideButton.Parent = header
Instance.new("UICorner", hideButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 9)
closeButton.Text = "×"
closeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeButton.TextSize = 20
closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 57, 72)
closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeButton.Parent = header
Instance.new("UICorner", closeButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
status.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 62)
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 24)
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = "STATUS: DISABLED"
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 185)
status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
status.TextSize = 12
status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
status.Parent = main

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 96)
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 45)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 66)
toggle.Text = "▶   ENABLE TELEPORT"
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggle.TextSize = 13
toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggle.AutoButtonColor = true
toggle.Parent = main
Instance.new("UICorner", toggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local info = Instance.new("TextLabel")
info.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 151)
info.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 35)
info.BackgroundTransparency = 1
info.Text = "Auto teleport: every 1 second\nInsert — show / hide panel"
info.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 157, 180)
info.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
info.TextSize = 11
info.TextWrapped = true
info.Parent = main

local toggleSound = Instance.new("Sound")
toggleSound.Name = "ToggleSound"
toggleSound.SoundId = TOGGLE_SOUND_ID
toggleSound.Volume = 0.7
toggleSound.Parent = gui

local function playToggleSound()
	pcall(function()
		toggleSound.TimePosition = 0
		toggleSound:Play()
	end)
end

local function updateUI()
	if enabled then
		toggle.Text = "■   DISABLE TELEPORT"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 150, 105)
		status.Text = "STATUS: ACTIVE"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 240, 170)
	else
		toggle.Text = "▶   ENABLE TELEPORT"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 66)
		status.Text = "STATUS: DISABLED"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 185)
	end
end

local function teleportOnce()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		return
	end

	-- This is intended for your own Roblox experience.
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(TARGET_POSITION)
end

local function startTeleportLoop()
	if teleporting then return end
	teleporting = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while enabled do
			local ok, err = pcall(teleportOnce)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Teleport Panel] Teleport error:", err)
			end

			task.wait(TELEPORT_INTERVAL)
		end

		teleporting = false
	end)
end

local function setEnabled(value)
	if enabled == value then return end

	enabled = value
	updateUI()
	playToggleSound()

	if enabled then
		startTeleportLoop()
	end
end

toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
	setEnabled(not enabled)
end)

--Insert
local function setPanelOpen(value)
	panelOpen = value

	if panelOpen then
		main.Visible = true
		main.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		TweenService:Create(
			main,
			TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{BackgroundTransparency = 0}
		):Play()
	else
		main.Visible = false
	end
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then
		setPanelOpen(not panelOpen)
	end
end)

hideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setPanelOpen(false)
end)

closeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setEnabled(false)
	gui:Destroy()
end)

-- panel
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos
local dragInput

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = main.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

header.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and input == dragInput then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		main.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

updateUI()
print("[Teleport Panel Pro] Loaded")

scripts.title: wins auto farm
scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Auto Farm GUI by Sqilss",
    LoadingTitle = "Teleport + Auto Rebirth + Auto Walk",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by Sqilss",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = true,
        FolderName = "AutoFarmHub",
        FileName = "AutoConfig"
    },
    KeySystem = false
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)

-- ==================== TELEPORT LOOP ====================
local teleportLoop = false
local teleportConnection = nil

local function startTeleportLoop()
    if teleportConnection then return end
    teleportConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not teleportLoop then
            teleportConnection:Disconnect()
            teleportConnection = nil
            return
        end
        local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(155.33, 89.82, -3046.06)
        end
    end)
end

local ToggleTeleport = Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Win farm (On/Off)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        teleportLoop = Value
        if Value then
            startTeleportLoop()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Teleport Loop", Content = "Enabled - Constant teleport active", Duration = 5})
        else
            if teleportConnection then teleportConnection:Disconnect() teleportConnection = nil end
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Teleport Loop", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

-- ==================== AUTO REBIRTH ====================
local autoRebirth = false
local rebirthConnection = nil

local function startAutoRebirth()
    if rebirthConnection then return end
    rebirthConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not autoRebirth then
            rebirthConnection:Disconnect()
            rebirthConnection = nil
            return
        end
        -- Fire the rebirth remote
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.Net["RE/Rebirth"]:FireServer()
        end)
        if not success then
            warn("Rebirth remote failed: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
end

local ToggleRebirth = Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Rebirth (On/Off)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        autoRebirth = Value
        if Value then
            startAutoRebirth()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Auto Rebirth", Content = "Enabled - Rebirthing every frame", Duration = 5})
        else
            if rebirthConnection then rebirthConnection:Disconnect() rebirthConnection = nil end
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Auto Rebirth", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

-- ==================== AUTO WALK ====================
local autoWalk = false
local walkConnection = nil

local function startAutoWalk()
    if walkConnection then return end
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    
    walkConnection = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not autoWalk then
            walkConnection:Disconnect()
            walkConnection = nil
            return
        end
        
        local character = player.Character
        if character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local humanoid = character.Humanoid
            -- Move forward relative to camera (you can still turn with mouse)
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), true)
        end
    end)
end

local ToggleWalk = Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Walk (On/Off)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        autoWalk = Value
        if Value then
            startAutoWalk()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Auto Walk", Content = "Enabled - Walking forward automatically", Duration = 5})
        else
            if walkConnection then walkConnection:Disconnect() walkConnection = nil end
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Auto Walk", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

-- ==================== ONE-TIME TELEPORT ====================
local Button = Tab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Teleport Once (to coords)",
    Callback = function()
        local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character or game.Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(155.33, 89.82, -3046.06)
        Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Teleported", Content = "One-time teleport done", Duration = 3})
    end,
})

Rayfield:Notify({
    Title = "GUI Loaded Successfully",
    Content = "Use the toggles for Auto Rebirth, Auto Walk & Teleport Loop",
    Duration = 6
})
